newsitem.title: BAHRAIN: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - June 23.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Saudi newspapers - June 23.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Saudi Arabian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Saudi Aramco to invest 15 billion riyals on gas network project.
- Lawyers to prove that the mother and brother of an Australian nurse killed in Saudi Arabia are her heirs and could demand execution if the alleged killers are found guilty.
- Joining World Trade Organisation will boost Saudi Arabia's petrochemical exports, official says.
- Riyadh chamber of commerce offers 32 investment opportunities to businessmen.
- Dammam governor inaugurates a number of projects in Jubail worth 20 million riyals.
- King Fahd receives Food and Agriculture Organisation's highest gold medal for 1997 for kingdom's efforts in agricultural development.
- Saudi Arabia urges Arab and Islamic countries to implement death penalty against drug traffickers.
